title: Back into the line
brief: You have gone out to engage their winger on your side.
briefKid: You went out to their winger near you.
question: The winger has played it back inside. Where do you go now?
questionKid: Their winger passed it back inside. Where do you go now?

takeaway.standard: As soon as the ball leaves your winger, get back into the line level with your centre-back, so nobody can run in behind you.
takeaway.kid: When the ball leaves your winger, get back in line with your defenders.

misconceptions.text: You stayed out with their winger after the ball moved away from them, so the gap between you and your centre-back is open.
misconceptions.textKid: The ball has gone inside. Get back in line with your defenders.

misconceptions.text: You dropped behind your back line, which keeps their forwards onside; get level with your centre-back instead.
misconceptions.textKid: Too deep! Stand in line with your other defenders.
